qualification_limits: One board, this exact image, configured 16 MHz and 115200 baud only.
Cold flags prove power-reset entry; two saved 500 ms ticks do not prove uninterrupted execution for the whole host wait.
The source and timing of the intervening external reset were not measured.
Pure watchdog-only reset cause 08 without EXTRF was not qualified.
Unchanged Boot under CF establishes combined software/hardware protection.
Arduino IDE smoke sketch and MiniCore package overrides have not been run on this host.
